reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Composition v1 schema: 1 field added: `spec.pipeline[].requirements`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Existing Composition resources without these fields continue to work unchanged; the fields are available for optional use in new or updated Compositions.

proposed.statement: New optional fields spec.pipeline[].requirements and its subfields (requiredResources, apiVersion, kind, matchLabels, name, namespace, requirementName) have been added to the apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1 Composition schema.
